# Docs

Helps write documentation.

## Persian

Persian requires a zero-width non-joiner between certain letters. Without it the
words are misspelled, so it appears throughout ordinary Persian text:

می‌خواهم این پروژه را مستند کنم و نتیجه را با تیم به اشتراک بگذارم.

می‌توانید نسخه فارسی را در پوشه docs قرار دهید.

## Mixed paragraphs

A document containing both English and Русский paragraphs is entirely ordinary.
What is not ordinary is a single word drawing letters from both alphabets, and
only that narrower case is worth reporting.
